summary: Applied data professional with experience building reliable analytical pipelines, evaluated predictive models and clear decision-support tools. Combines structured problem framing, careful validation and concise communication to move work from raw data to practical use without overstating results or hiding limitations.

skills.items: Python, SQL, pandas, NumPy and Git
forecasting, regression, classification, cross-validation and calibration
ETL, data-quality checks, CI/CD, testing, dashboards and documentation

bullets: Built a repeatable forecasting workflow from operational data, benchmarked candidate methods on held-out periods and documented the assumptions used in monthly planning.
Automated validation and reporting checks, reducing manual preparation time and giving stakeholders a clearer view of missing, stale and inconsistent inputs.
Created compact dashboards and written summaries that translated model behaviour into concrete planning decisions for non-technical colleagues.
Developed Python and SQL transformations for scheduled data pipelines and added checks for schema drift, duplicate records and failed loads.
Worked with analysts and software engineers to trace data issues, improve documentation and stabilise recurring production jobs.

education.details: Modules included predictive modelling, data management and decision analytics.

projects.title: Demand Forecasting Workbench
bullets: Built a reproducible forecasting comparison with baseline, tree-based and statistical models across multiple horizons.
Added a lightweight interface, tests and clear notes on data leakage, evaluation windows and model limitations.
